idea-plugin.name: Rider Remote
idea-plugin.description: Exposes a REST API for external tools to control Rider. Supports build, run, diagnostics, and status queries.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.0.5: - StopHandler now triggers Rider Stop action via ActionManager (Ctrl+F2) - All actions (Build, Run, Debug, Stop) now execute on EDT for proper IDE integration
v1.0.4: - RunHandler now triggers Rider internal Debug/Run actions via ActionManager - Debug mode (Shift+F9) now properly executes on EDT
v1.0.3: - Extended build action detection list: Cpp.BuildProject, CMake.BuildProject, BuildProject, BuildMenu - User-specified target action ID is now checked first
v1.0.2: - Fixed threading issue: build action now executes on EDT via invokeLater - Build API auto-detects available build actions (Build, CompileProject, MakeProject, etc.)
v1.0.1: - Build API now triggers Rider internal build action (shows progress in IDE) - Removed hardcoded project paths, plugin is now universal for any UE5 project - Fixed Ktor/CIO server type compatibility
v1.0.0: - Initial release with REST API for build/run/diagnostics.

action.description: Start or stop the remote HTTP server
